zh.title: 摄影规划、多语言与反馈
zh.summary: 新增多日摄影规划与机位时段对比，支持 42 种语言，并提供反馈入口。

items.text: 多日总览：在「天文」中比较未来 7 天的拍摄窗口与天气，包括新降雪和地面积雪，或查看 30 天天文日历。所有日期选择统一从浏览器当前年份的上一年 1 月 1 日开始，跨年后自动更新。
机位时段对比：收藏机位支持按整天、无月、银河、日落前后或自选时段比较天气。自选时段限同一时区。
反馈与建议：在「关于」中提交问题或功能建议，可附截图。
天气表雪况与阵风：两种来源均可查看新降雪、积雪和阵风，完整 24 小时雪水当量可按国标分级，等级见天气图例。Open-Meteo 用雪花数量表示降雪强度，并汇总 24 小时新雪厚度。雪况可设为有雪时显示、始终显示或隐藏。
多语言：支持 42 种语言，可跟随 Windy 或单独设置；所有语言的短日期统一为月/日，其他语言按需下载并缓存，减小插件体积。紧凑按钮与设置页采用简短文案，窄屏导航和语言框以省略号显示长名称，避免拆词撑高。核对 Windy 术语，修正城市热力图、热气流、户外地图、晴空湍流及波浪功率等图层名称。新增翻译尚未全部经母语者审校。

en.title: Photography planning, languages and feedback
en.summary: Plan shoots across days, compare time windows at favorite sites, choose from 42 languages and share feedback.

items.text: Multi-day overview: compare shooting windows and weather, including new snow and ground snow depth, over seven days in Astro, or browse a 30-day astronomy calendar. All date selectors start no earlier than January 1 of the previous year, based on the browser’s current year, and advance at New Year.
Site comparisons: compare favorite sites over whole days, moonless, Milky Way, sunset or custom windows. Custom periods require sites in one time zone.
Feedback: report issues or suggest features from About, with optional screenshots.

Snow and gusts in the weather table: both sources show new snow, ground snow depth and gusts. The weather legend lists the Chinese national grades for complete 24-hour snow water equivalent totals. Open-Meteo uses snowflake counts for intensity and summarizes 24-hour new snow depth. Snow display can be automatic, always shown or hidden.

Languages: choose from 42 languages, follow Windy or set your own. Short dates use month/day in every language. Other languages download individually and are cached to reduce plugin size. Compact controls and Settings use shorter labels, while narrow navigation and language selectors show ellipses for long names instead of splitting words across lines. Reviewed Windy terminology and corrected labels for city heatmaps, thermals, outdoor maps, clear air turbulence and wave power. New translations have not all been reviewed by native speakers.
